question: Should 0.38.4 land through this combined release branch or through the dedicated Homebrew fix pull request followed by separate release metadata?
rationale: Both open branches contain commit 9497eb20f4a70051dc9a382650f2c3a5a53e38e5, while only this branch adds 0.38.4 metadata, so choosing the authoritative serialized release path requires release-owner intent.

options.title: Use combined release branch
options.body: Merge this PR as the sole 0.38.4 landing path and close https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1090 after the shared fix lands.

options.title: Split fix and release
options.body: Merge https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1090 first, then rebase or recreate a metadata-only 0.38.4 release change.

recommendation.title: Use combined release branch
recommendation.body: Merge this PR as the sole 0.38.4 landing path and close https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/pull/1090 after the shared fix lands.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed release sequence and signed/tagged v0.38.3, making them the clearest available release decision owner.
